# TeacherPoint

> Global edtech platform connecting students with verified tutors, online courses, workshops, and student exchange listings.

- Public site: https://www.teacherpoint.org
- API (server-side): https://api.teacherpoint.org/api/v1

## Primary offerings

- Tutor search and hire (online and home tutoring)
- Student/parent job posts (tutoring requirements)
- Teacher job applications
- Razorpay checkout for tutor connection unlock (live payments)
- Courses and workshops
- Student marketplace (exchange listings)
- Accommodation discovery and enquiries

## Documentation

Production readiness notes: see repository `docs/production-readiness/` (maintainers).
